sources.title: 3D Studio — AI 3D Character Generator with Automatic Rigging
sources.snippet: 3D Studio turns a text prompt into a fully rigged, fully animated, game-ready 3D asset. AI image generation, single-image to textured 3D model, automatic humanoid rigging with weight-paint refinement, AI text-to-animation, and a single universal GLB export that drops straight into Unity, Unreal Engine, Godot, Blender, Three.js, Babylon.js, Roblox, and AI vibe-coded games.
